$comment: Patches that are infrastructure: they make other patches possible rather
than making a sound. They earn a place in the library because they are
what a person actually asks for when a patch nearly works -- 'send this
to two places', 'make it stay in key', 'get it out to the speakers'.

implies: send it to the audio interface
idioms.is: Whatever the patch makes, arriving at the audio interface — the connection whose absence makes every other correct patch silent.

topology.describe: something has to reach the audio output, or the patch is silent however correct it is

idioms.is: One signal split so several destinations receive exactly the same voltage, which is what keeps parts of a patch in agreement.
idioms.sounds_right_when: the destinations move together rather than independently.

topology.describe: a signal has to reach the multiple
the copies have to go somewhere

common_mistakes.message: the multiple has nothing to split

idioms.is: Several signals summed to one path, so they share an output and can be balanced against each other.
idioms.sounds_right_when: you hear all the parts, at chosen relative levels.

topology.describe: sources have to reach the mixer
the mix has to go somewhere

idioms.is: One clock split to every timed part, so the patch stays in agreement about when now is.
idioms.sounds_right_when: the parts stay locked rather than drifting.

topology.describe: the clock has to be split rather than reaching only one destination
the copies have to reach the timed parts

idioms.is: A clocked switch sending successive events to different destinations, so one source feeds several voices in turn.
idioms.sounds_right_when: successive events clearly come from different places.
idioms.source: Standard practice; the poor man's polyphony

topology.describe: the switch has to be clocked, or it never rotates
the switch's outputs have to reach destinations

common_mistakes.message: the switch is never clocked, so it never rotates

idioms.is: A voltage scaled and shifted so it lands in the range its destination expects, which is what makes a modulation source usable rather than merely present.
idioms.sounds_right_when: the destination moves across its useful range rather than sitting at an extreme.

axis.set_by: the processor's gain and offset knobs — a knob, not a cable, so every position on this axis patches identically
axis.$comment: A voltage through a processor and on to its destination. Attenuating, inverting and offsetting are the same three jacks; what differs is where the knobs sit. Separate records still earn their place: somebody asking to bring a voltage into range is not asking for an inverter.

topology.describe: the voltage has to reach the offset stage
the shifted voltage has to reach its destination

common_mistakes.message: the offset stage has no input

implies: make a trigger from a gate
idioms.is: A sustained gate converted to a momentary trigger, so something that wants an edge gets one.
idioms.sounds_right_when: the destination fires once per gate rather than staying open.

topology.describe: a gate has to reach the converter
the trigger has to reach something

idioms.is: Two related but not identical signals sent to left and right, so the image has width rather than a single centred point.
idioms.sounds_right_when: the two sides differ enough to hear width, and still belong together.

topology.describe: a signal has to reach the output
the two sides have to differ, or the image is mono however it is wired

common_mistakes.message: both sides carry the same thing, so the image is mono
